zh-Hant.title: 海事青年領袖訓練
zh-Hant.kicker: 「破浪同行：現代青年領袖的溝通與共融智慧」領袖培訓
zh-Hant.summary: 國際特殊教育協會與香港海事青年團普照分隊首度合辦「破浪同行：現代青年領袖的溝通與共融智慧」領袖培訓，透過心理專業帶領、體驗式學習及團隊實戰，培養青年溝通、協作、領導及 SEN 共融能力。
description: 🌊 航向未來，以共融之心定義新時代領袖力！
為培養具備共情力與卓越溝通力的青年領袖，國際特殊教育協會於今年暑假邁出突破性的一步，首度攜手香港海事青年團普照分隊，盛大舉辦「破浪同行：現代青年領袖的溝通與共融智慧」深度培訓課程。
這不只是一場訓練，更是一次打破框架、凝聚力量的成長之旅！
✨ 三大活動核心亮點
專業心理師與顧問導領：由兒童心理輔導專家、家庭教育顧問及註冊心理諮詢師親自帶領，深入剖析人際溝通核心，引導隊員從內而外建立強大的心理素質。
體驗式學習與多元實戰：擺脫傳統課堂限制，透過情境式團隊合作與動態任務，讓隊員在實作中淬鍊傳意技巧、協作默契與臨場領導力。
實踐 SEN 共融文化：將「共融」理念轉化為具體行動！培養隊員的同理心與多元包容視野，並鼓勵將這份智慧帶回團隊與社區，共同為特殊教育需要（SEN）群體締造更友善的社會環境。
💡 乘風破浪，攜手共好
我們相信，真正的領袖不僅能引領方向，更能包容差異、凝聚人心。期待隊員們在此次培訓中汲取養份，成為傳播共融種子的青年領袖！

en.title: Maritime Youth Leadership Training
en.kicker: “Sailing Together: Communication and Inclusion Wisdom for Modern Youth Leaders” Leadership Training
en.summary: ISEdA and the Hong Kong Sea Cadet Corps Po Chiu Unit co-hosted “Sailing Together: Communication and Inclusion Wisdom for Modern Youth Leaders”, using professional guidance, experiential learning and team practice to develop young people’s communication, collaboration, leadership and SEN inclusion skills.
description: 🌊 Sailing towards the future, defining leadership for a new era through inclusion!

To nurture young leaders with empathy and excellent communication skills, ISEdA took a breakthrough step this summer by co-hosting the in-depth “Sailing Together: Communication and Inclusion Wisdom for Modern Youth Leaders” training programme with the Hong Kong Sea Cadet Corps Po Chiu Unit for the first time.
This was more than a training session; it was a growth journey that broke boundaries and brought people together.
✨ Three core highlights

Professional psychologists and consultants: Child psychology counselling experts, family education consultants and a registered psychological counsellor led the programme, exploring the foundations of interpersonal communication and helping members build inner psychological strength.

Experiential learning and diverse practice: Through scenario-based teamwork and dynamic tasks, members sharpened their communication techniques, collaborative understanding and leadership under pressure through hands-on practice.

Putting SEN inclusion into practice: The programme turned inclusion into concrete action, nurturing empathy and a broader perspective on diversity while encouraging members to bring this wisdom back to their teams and communities to help create a friendlier environment for people with special educational needs (SEN).
💡 Sailing through challenges, growing together

We believe that a true leader does more than set a direction: a true leader embraces differences and brings people together. We hope the members gained valuable insight from this training and will become young leaders who spread the seeds of inclusion.
